For teachers and tutors

About Beginner Tap Word

A decoding game with short rhyming words. The learner hears "pen" and chooses from pen, hen, ten and men. The words differ by one sound, so the learner has to read the first letter, not guess. It uses the same word families as Beginner Sound Gap.

How to play

  1. Listen to the word.
  2. Read the rhyming words.
  3. Tap the one you heard.

Play it as a class

Choose Beginner Tap Word in the Teacher Game. The word is spoken from the projector and students tap it on their phones.
